gloss_en: I want to send an email to the manager now
notes: [tech] email→imeːl (mid-long /eː/ native). biddi 'I want' (alwer2020); ق→[ɡ] hallaɡ (Al-Wer 2020:560). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I have an important meeting with the manager
notes: [tech] meeting→miːtinɡ (/ŋ/→[nɡ], JO declares /ɡ/). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964). Ammani koine ق→[ɡ], ج→[dʒ] (Al-Wer 2020); frame cowell1964/alwer2020

gloss_en: did you see the manager in the office
notes: [work] manager→manadʒar (loan ǧīm [dʒ], the Ammani jīm reflex; Al-Wer 2020). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I bought a new laptop but it is expensive
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b] onset and coda). ج=[dʒ] dʒdiːd (alwer2020); bass 'but'. table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

sentence: بِدِّي أَشْتَرِي online مِش مِن الْمَحَلّ
raw: بدي أشتري online مش من المحل
ipa: ˈbiddiː ˈʔaʃtariː unlin ˈmiʃ ˈmin almaˈħall
gloss_en: I want to buy online, not from the shop
notes: [commerce] online→unlin. miš nominal negation (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I think this is expensive
notes: [daily] think→θink (Levantine loan table retains interdental /θ/; note Ammani natively favours stop variants of ث, Al-Wer 2020). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I took the car to the garage
notes: [automotive] garage→ɡaːradʒ (/ɡ/ + retained loan [dʒ]). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

sentence: مِنْحْكِي بِالْ weekend إِنْ شَاءَ الله
raw: منحكي بال weekend إن شاء الله
ipa: ˈminħkiː ˈbil wiːkind ˈʔin ˈʃaːʔa ˈallah
gloss_en: we'll talk on the weekend, God willing
notes: [daily] weekend→wiːkind. mn- 1pl imperfect minħki (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

sentence: نَزَّلْت الْ file بَسّ الْ download بَطِيء
raw: نزلت ال file بس ال download بطيء
ipa: naˈzzalt ˈal fil ˈbass ˈal dawnloːud bɑˈtˤiːʔ
gloss_en: I downloaded the file but the download is slow
notes: [tech] file→fil; download→dawnloːud (/əʊ/→[oː] monophthong, native to Levantine mid-long vowels). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: there is an offer and a big discount
notes: [commerce] offer→ufar; discount→disawnt. table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I paid cash, not by card
notes: [commerce] cash→kaʃ. miš negation (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: the wifi is slow today
notes: [tech] wifi→wifi (both segments native). aw→oː il-yōm (fadda2016). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I have a flat tyre in the car
notes: [automotive] Arabic-script loan banšar 'flat tyre/puncture' (< Eng. puncture; everyday Jordanian form). Pipeline reads the vocalised word faithfully → banʃar, the attested realisation. Ammani koine ق→[ɡ], ج→[dʒ] (Al-Wer 2020); frame cowell1964/alwer2020

gloss_en: the computer is slow today
notes: [tech] Arabic-script loan kambyūtar 'computer'. Pipeline reads it faithfully → kambjuːtar, the attested realisation. aw→oː il-yōm (fadda2016).

gloss_en: I forgot the mobile at home
notes: [tech] Arabic-script loan mōbāyl 'mobile phone'. Attested Ammani realisation /moˈbajl/. Pipeline over-reads و as [uː] and inserts a leading length artifact → almuˈːbaːjl (wrong); correct loan IPA pinned here.

gloss_en: this car is automatic
notes: [automotive] Arabic-script loan otomatik 'automatic' (< Fr./Eng. automatique). Attested realisation /ʔotomaˈtik/. Pipeline over-lengthens → ʔuːtuːmaˈːtiːk (wrong); correct loan IPA pinned here.

gloss_en: I want to buy a new television
notes: [tech] Arabic-script loan tilifizyōn 'television'. Attested Jordanian realisation /tilifizˈjoːn/ (يون → [joːn]). Pipeline reads و as [uː] → tilifiˈzjuːn (wrong final vowel); correct loan IPA pinned here.

gloss_en: hi, how are you, everything ok
notes: [greeting] Ammani Arabizi: 7=ح. Spells مَرْحَبَا كِيفَك كِلّ شِي تَمَام (kīfak; kill ši tamām; cowell1964/alwer2020). Pipeline has no Arabizi path (reads Latin as en-GB loan); IPA hand-derived from the Arabic it spells.

gloss_en: I want to go to the market tomorrow
notes: [daily] Ammani Arabizi: 7=ح, 3=ع, soug=سُوق with ق→[ɡ]. Spells بِدِّي أَرُوح عَ السُّوق بُكْرَا (Al-Wer 2020:560 ق=[ɡ]). Pipeline has no Arabizi path; IPA hand-derived from the Arabic.

gloss_en: right now I am talking to you
notes: [daily] Ammani Arabizi: 7=ح, 3=ع, hassa 'now' (alwer2020). Spells هَسَّا أَنَا بَحْكِي مَعَك. Pipeline has no Arabizi path; IPA hand-derived from the Arabic.
